objective: Evaluate frozen ROCK2 predictor on a separate publication with a verified non-luciferase biochemical readout before considering novel screening.
selection_rule: Select the first candidate in this order with accessible primary methods, verified target species, independently reconciled structures and IC50 table labels, at least 20 eligible unique compounds, and a viable deterministic scaffold split. Document failures before considering a later candidate. No predictions used in selection.
inclusion: Primary experimental non-luciferase ROCK2 IC50 only; do not pool assays or cellular endpoints.
Verify source species and construct; human model mismatch must be disclosed and may make assay ineligible.
Exclude molecule-ID, isomeric and achiral structural overlaps with Phase17 and Phase18.
Primary-source supported exact positive IC50 <=10000 nM; preserve censored bounds and exclusions separately.
Collapse identical structures only with agreeing exact labels; conflicting or unresolvable identities excluded before prediction.
split: Sort Murcko scaffold strings by SHA256(cryo-phase19-split-1900: + scaffold), fill calibration with whole groups until at least ceil(n/3); remaining groups test. Require >=6 calibration and >=10 test compounds, at least2 test scaffolds. Do not search alternative seeds to improve a split.
model: Unchanged Phase17 protein sequence, MSA, template, Boltz2.2.1 settings; seeds1901/1902. No label inputs.
analysis: Same primary and calibration gates as Phase18. Source-only constants fitted on Phase17; Phase18 offsets/test labels not used to fit or choose Phase19 predictions. Median additive calibration fitted on Phase19 calibration subset only.
qualification: Another retrospective assay can diagnose transfer but cannot establish prospective novelty, unseen-pretraining independence, cellular survival or cryoprotection. Preserve failed prior results.
fallback: If neither candidate qualifies, record the specific source/eligibility gap. Any same-compound Phase18 IMAP diagnostic is exploratory reuse, not fresh validation.
spending: No GPU allocation until source audit, frozen plan, tests, and fresh cumulative budget reconciliation. User total cap remains $10.
